educationalNotice: This severity scale is an educational model mapping real solar observations to simulated base risk points. Never convert a flare or CME record into an actual astronaut radiation dose.

mappings.description: Minor solar brightening. Negligible proton flux enhancement.
Moderate solar flare. Slight increase in background particle levels.
Substantial coronal mass ejection directed toward inner solar system.
Major flare accompanied by energetic relativistic protons reaching lunar orbit.
